dataset.inclusion_rule: observed (complete base, C4', C3') at >= 60 consensus positions of the aptamer core; comparisons use the 43 positions observed in every included instance
dataset.fixed_correspondence: Rfam consensus match states observed with complete base atoms in every eligible instance

mapping_check.result: every clustered instance has a match-state residue with coordinates at every shared position

discrepancy.label: Geometric discrepancy
discrepancy.unit: dimensionless (base-centre deviation in A and base rotation in rad, weight 1, divided by n)
discrepancy.definition: D = sqrt(L + O) / n after Kabsch superposition of the n base centres: L = sum of squared base-centre deviations, O = sum of squared base-rotation angles (FR3D standard base frames); fixed correspondence on the n shared Rfam consensus positions
discrepancy.values_layout: row-major upper triangle (i < j) in dataset.instances order; diagonal 0

cut.rule: undo the k - 1 highest merges; height midway between the lowest merge undone and the highest kept

groups.label: Structural group 1
groups.representative_rule: medoid among members without internal coordinate gaps

clustering.rationale: Groups: the canonical L-shaped majority (56 chains); the mitoribosome central-protuberance mt-tRNAs 7QI4 JA + 8OIN I; the aIF2-bound initiator tRNA 3QSY C; the lambda-form tRNA 1J2B A bound to archaeosine TGT (D-arm displaced by up to 24 A). k = 4 has the second-largest merge-height gap (0.175), element-jackknife ARI 1.0 for every element and holds in 84 % of 100 position-bootstrap replicates (median ARI 1.0, 5th percentile 0.49); T60 vs T68 ARI 0.72. No cut meets the strict stable rule (k = 2: 5th percentile -0.02 over 100 replicates), so the cut is provisional. The groups separate structurally unusual tRNAs from one canonical group; they are not binding-context classes. Chosen by the user on 2026-10-17.

floor.definition: 95th percentile of the duplicate pairs (NCS copies, isomorphous re-determinations); smaller differences are not interpretable. Not shown: only 2 duplicate pairs exist in the 60-chain set (one crystal copy, one same-sequence same-context pair), too few for a noise floor

tm.label: TM-score
tm.definition: US-align TM-score with fixed residue correspondence (-mol RNA -I <pair.fasta> -u n), normalised by the n shared positions (symmetric); clustering and the dendrogram use 1 - TM-score
tm.values_layout: row-major upper triangle (i < j) in dataset.instances order; diagonal 1

cut.rule: undo the k - 1 highest merges; height midway between the lowest merge undone and the highest kept

clustering.rationale: The 1 - TM tree (fixed correspondence) has no dominant gap (k = 2-8 gaps 0.002-0.063 at T60) and low silhouettes (<= 0.23). k = 5 is the largest gap at T68 (0.085) and identical at T60 and T68 (ARI 1.0): the same four groups as discrepancy, plus 5CCB C (TRMT6/61A-bound tRNA-Lys3) split from the main group. No bootstrap or jackknife exists for TM: provisional. Chosen by the user on 2026-10-17.

floor.definition: 95th percentile of the duplicate pairs (NCS copies, isomorphous re-determinations); smaller differences are not interpretable. Not shown: only 2 duplicate pairs exist in the 60-chain set (one crystal copy, one same-sequence same-context pair), too few for a noise floor
